query.statement: SELECT LOT_ID, MATERIAL_ID, LOT_NO, WAREHOUSE, CURRENT_QTY, UNIT, STATUS, RECEIVED_AT, EXPIRY_AT FROM IVT_MATERIAL_LOT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@warehouse IS NULL OR WAREHOUSE = @warehouse) AND (@materialId IS NULL OR MATERIAL_ID = @materialId) ORDER BY LOT_ID

SELECT TX_ID, LOT_ID, MATERIAL_ID, TX_TYPE, QTY, FROM_WAREHOUSE, TO_WAREHOUSE, TX_AT, PROCESSED_BY, STATUS FROM IVT_MATERIAL_TX WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@txType IS NULL OR TX_TYPE = @txType) ORDER BY TX_AT DESC
SELECT TX_ID, LOT_ID, MATERIAL_ID, TX_TYPE, QTY, FROM_WAREHOUSE, TO_WAREHOUSE, TX_AT, PROCESSED_BY, STATUS FROM IVT_MATERIAL_TX WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE TX_TYPE = 'Incoming' ORDER BY TX_AT DESC
SELECT TX_ID, LOT_ID, MATERIAL_ID, TX_TYPE, QTY, FROM_WAREHOUSE, TO_WAREHOUSE, TX_AT, PROCESSED_BY, STATUS FROM IVT_MATERIAL_TX WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE TX_TYPE = 'Move' ORDER BY TX_AT DESC
SELECT TX_ID, LOT_ID, MATERIAL_ID, TX_TYPE, QTY, FROM_WAREHOUSE, TO_WAREHOUSE, TX_AT, PROCESSED_BY, STATUS FROM IVT_MATERIAL_TX WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE TX_TYPE = 'Dispensing' ORDER BY TX_AT DESC
